result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the profile/avatar button in the top-right header appears empty (a blank gray circle with only a notification dot), which reads as a broken or missing image. A minor cosmetic inconsistency exists in the 'Fastest near you' thumbnail backgrounds.

issues.description: The circular avatar/profile button at the top-right of the header is an empty light-gray circle containing only a small red notification dot. No user image, initials, or placeholder icon is rendered, making it look like a failed image load.
issues.suggestion: Render a proper fallback (user initials or a person icon) inside the avatar circle when no profile image is available, and ensure the notification badge is positioned on the circle's edge rather than floating in an empty area.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card uses a light/neutral background while the following cards use dark blurred backgrounds, creating an inconsistent visual treatment across sibling cards.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image background/overlay treatment (e.g., uniform blur or neutral backdrop) across all carousel thumbnails for visual cohesion.
